procedures.title: Reset Warning After No Liquid Detection
preconditions: Red and blue LED blinking alternatively
steps: Option 1: Reboot the circuit
Option 2: Press the Reset button on control panel (if present)

procedures.title: Power Supply Voltage Check
preconditions: Yellow and blue LED blinking together
steps: Check wire section for power supply
Check battery charge level if battery present

procedures.title: Reset Low Speed Timeout Warning
preconditions: Steady red and blinking blue LED
steps: Option 1: Reboot the circuit
Option 2: Press the Reset button on control panel (if present)

procedures.title: Expansion Tank Installation
preconditions: Short rigid pipes or presence of solenoid valves
steps: Install expansion tank of minimum 0.5 liter capacity
Position tank to prevent water hammer effect
Ensure proper connection to system
procedures.expected_outcome: Prevention of overpressure damage to pressure sensor

procedures.title: System Installation with Appliances
preconditions: Presence of dryers or ice machines in system
steps: Install expansion vessel
Connect vessel to system
Verify proper operation
procedures.expected_outcome: Prevention of pump overheating during continuous use

procedures.title: Air Vent Valve Operation
steps: Slightly open the small valve when starting pump
Allow air to escape to facilitate priming
Close the small valve once pump is operating
Install at least 1m length of flexible tubing on outlet side

procedures.title: LED Status Monitoring
preconditions: Electronic pressure sensor system is powered
steps: Observe blue LED for liquid presence status
Monitor multicolored LED for pressure and operation status
Verify normal operation through LED indicators
error_codes: Solid green - Target pressure reached with constant flow
Solid/slow flashing red - Short circuit detected

procedures.title: Short Circuit Error Resolution
preconditions: Red LED is solid or slowly flashing
steps: Check for blocked gears
Inspect pump-circuit connection
Wait for automatic retry (up to 3 attempts)
If error persists after 4th attempt, check for permanent damage
Reboot circuit or press Reset button to clear error

procedures.title: Overload Error Resolution
steps: Check liquid viscosity is appropriate for pump
Verify gears move freely
Allow automatic speed reduction for 30 seconds
Monitor for repeated overload (up to 3 attempts)
Reboot circuit or press Reset button if pump turns off

procedures.title: Temperature Range Compliance
steps: Ensure ambient temperature is above -10°C/14°F
Ensure ambient temperature is below +60°C/140°F
Monitor temperature of all pump components
procedures.expected_outcome: Pump operates within safe temperature limits

procedures.title: Transportation and Handling Procedure
steps: Wear appropriate safety gear (safety shoes with toe piece)
Handle manually due to limited weight
Inspect packaging for damage upon receipt
Store pump in dry area
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe transport and storage of pump

procedures.title: Installation Pre-Check Procedure
steps: Inspect pump for transportation or storage damage
Clean inlet port thoroughly removing dust and packaging material
Clean outlet port thoroughly removing dust and packaging material
Verify electrical power supply matches specification requirements

procedures.title: Fluid Compatibility Check
steps: Verify fluid is either water (max 85°C) or gasoline
Confirm fluid viscosity is less than 20 cSt
Ensure fluid is not a solvent
Ensure fluid is not corrosive
Verify fluid flash point is above 38°C if flammable

procedures.title: High Pressure Operation Management
steps: Monitor pump temperature
Monitor operating duration
Avoid prolonged operation at high pressure
Check for signs of stress or overheating
procedures.expected_outcome: Prevention of pump stress and overheating

procedures.title: Pump Assembly Parts Identification
steps: Identify pump body (Pos. 1)
Locate flange (Pos. 2)
Verify presence of two rods (Pos. 3)
Check armature assembly (Pos. 4)
Locate pump frame (Pos. 5)
Identify all O-rings (Pos. 6, 10, 16, 22, 25, 27)
Locate brush holder (Pos. 7)
Verify ball bearing (Pos. 8)
Check compensation spring (Pos. 9)
Locate driving and idle gears (Pos. 14, 15)
Identify electronic pressure sensor (Pos. 19)
Locate non-return valve (Pos. 20)
Verify antivibration mounts and inserts (Pos. 29, 30)
procedures.expected_outcome: All pump components correctly identified and accounted for

procedures.title: Replaceable Parts Identification
steps: Identify compensation spring (Pos. 9) as replaceable
Note idle gear (Pos. 15) as replaceable
Locate electronic control (Pos. 19) as replaceable
Check nipple (Pos. 24) as replaceable
Verify air vent cap (Pos. 26) as replaceable
Note O-ring (Pos. 27) as replaceable
Identify filter (Pos. 28) as replaceable
Check antivibration mount (Pos. 29) as replaceable
procedures.expected_outcome: All replaceable parts identified for maintenance purposes

procedures.title: Pump Priming Troubleshooting
steps: Check pump height relative to fluid level
Verify pump has not run dry for extended period
Inspect suction pipe for air leaks, cuts, or inadequate hose clamps
Check filter seals and clean clogged filter
Inspect front plate cover for loose screws and seal effectiveness
Verify electrical cable connections
Check for obstructions in suction/delivery pipes
Look for liquid loops in outlet tube

procedures.title: Extended Storage Preparation
preconditions: Pump will be unused for 30+ days
steps: Run fresh water through the pump
Loosen front plate screws
Upon re-use, run pump briefly for few seconds
Re-tighten screws
Check motor current value under maximum operating pressure

procedures.title: Normal Maintenance Routine
steps: Check and clean inlet filter frequently
Inspect and clean chamber monthly
Check electrical wiring condition monthly

procedures.title: Performance Monitoring
steps: Monitor body and motor frame temperature (should be 60°C-70°C)
Check for regular flow and constant noise levels
Verify amp-draw within specified limits

procedures.title: Environmental Disposal Procedure
steps: Contact local governing authorities
Identify specific refuse collection structures
Dispose through authorized channels

procedures.title: Packaging Disposal Procedure
steps: Separate waste materials
Sort packaging materials for recycling
Dispose through appropriate recycling channels

procedures.title: Initial Inspection and Storage
steps: Inspect packaging for damages
Store pump in a dry area

procedures.title: Preliminary Installation Checks
steps: Check pump for transportation or storage damage
Clean inlet and outlet ports of dust and packaging material
Verify electrical power supply matches specifications

procedures.title: Pump Positioning and Electrical Connection
steps: Mount pump in desired position using appropriate screws
Connect positive pole (+) of battery to red wire on motor end-cap
Connect negative pole (-) to black wire
Ensure tight fitment of electrical connections using adequate terminal blocks
procedures.expected_outcome: Pump properly mounted and electrically connected

procedures.title: Tubing Installation
steps: Check and remove any end caps from inlet ports
Position pump at appropriate height relative to fluid level
Ensure outlet tube is empty and unchoked
Install inlet filter if handling fluids with impurities (mesh ASTM no. 35)
Connect tubes and fittings resistant to handled fluids

procedures.title: Electrical Protection Installation
steps: Install protection fuse rated according to motor label
Mount anti-vibration rubber fittings
Install appropriately sized electrical cabling based on pump-to-power supply distance
Verify internal tube diameter matches Pump Data Table specifications
procedures.expected_outcome: Pump electrically protected and properly connected

procedures.title: Troubleshooting Non-Starting Pump
preconditions: Pump not starting or has stopped
steps: Check battery power supply voltage
Inspect fuse condition
Disconnect power supply
Unscrew four fixing screws
Remove front cover plate
Inspect chamber for foreign matter
Replace cover plate in original position

procedures.title: Maintenance Check - Motor Brushes
preconditions: 2500 hours of operation or pump stoppage
steps: Check motor commutator brushes for wear
Replace if necessary after 2500 hours of normal operation

procedures.title: Filter Installation
steps: Locate filter mounting position (component #28)
Install filter in designated location
Ensure proper orientation according to diagram
procedures.expected_outcome: Filter securely mounted in correct position

procedures.title: Antivibration Mount Installation
steps: Locate the 4 mounting points for antivibration mounts (#29)
Insert antivibration inserts (#30) into mounts if required
Secure antivibration mounts using appropriate screws (not included)
Verify mounts are properly seated

procedures.title: System Operating Parameters
steps: Monitor flow rate according to pressure chart
Maintain flow rate between 0-30 l/min
Monitor electrical absorption between 0-6A
Maintain pressure between 0-4 bar
models: UP6/E electronic water pressure system 26 l/min / gear pump
